view.lede: The Tight Track, left-handed: one of the five generic courses that every course without its own build races on for now (sharp oval with a sprint spur). A small, sharp oval of about 1m2f with tight turns, a 3½f run-in and a 6f sprint course carried on from the home straight. Dressed as a country course.
notes: Catterick, Musselburgh, Southwell, Thirsk, Ripon, Windsor.
About 10.5f round, a 3.32f run-in. Drawn from a few numbers (the corners and bends of the loop, the chutes), so it can be reshaped quickly.
Country course: medium and smaller pieces from the grandstand crib sheet on one front line, the crowd up to the rail; the festival in the infield opposite and up the stand side.
Choose Medium or Low under Quality in the race view's bar. Auto steps down by itself.
